raw_html: [[Alignment damage (weapon)#Holy|Holy]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alignment damage (weapon)#Holy|Holy]]:''' A holy weapon is imbued with holy power. This power makes the weapon good-aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon suffer a negative level. The weapon deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all targets of [[evil]] alignment.
